feeds.title: Dayton Christian Warriors
feeds.description: Dayton Christian Warriors is a private Christian school located in Dayton, Ohio. It was founded in 1963 by the First Baptist Church of Kettering, Ohio. The school's mission is to provide students with an excellent education while helping them to grow in their Christian faith. The Dayton Christian Warriors blog features updates about the school's sports teams, academic achievements, and student life.

feeds.title: Sisters of the Precious Blood Blog
feeds.description: It was founded in 1834 by Maria Anna Brunner and Father Francis de Sales Brunner. The community's mission is to help build the kingdom of God by proclaiming the Gospel and promoting justice, peace, and reconciliation. The Sisters of the Precious Blood blog features reflections on spirituality, social justice, and other topics of interest.

feeds.title: Fairhaven Church
feeds.description: Fairhaven Church is a non-denominational Christian church located in Dayton, Ohio. It was founded in 1918 as a Bible study group and has grown into a community of believers from all walks of life. The church's mission is to love God, love people, and make disciples. The Fairhaven Church blog features updates on worship services, community outreach, and other news.

feeds.title: Heavy Metal Church Blog
feeds.description: The Heavy Metal Church is a non-denominational Christian church located in Dayton, Ohio. It was founded in 2017 by Pastor Matt Smith. The church's mission is to reach people who may feel excluded or unwelcome in traditional churches by using heavy metal music and imagery to convey the message of the Gospel.

feeds.title: St. Vincent de Paul Dayton Blog
feeds.description: It was founded in 1885 by a group of Catholic laypeople who wanted to help the poor and marginalized in their community. The organization's mission is to provide emergency assistance, food, shelter, and other basic needs to those who are struggling. The St. Vincent de Paul Dayton blog features stories and updates about the organization's programs and services.

feeds.title: First Church of Dayton Blog
feeds.description: First Church of Dayton is a United Methodist congregation located in downtown Dayton, Ohio. It was founded in 1816, making it one of the oldest churches in the city. The church's mission is to love God and neighbor, to make disciples of Jesus Christ, and to be a beacon of hope and light in the community.

feeds.title: Sovereign Grace Church Dayton Blog
feeds.description: Sovereign Grace Church Dayton was founded in 2004 with a mission to make disciples of Jesus Christ in Dayton and beyond. The church is committed to preaching the Gospel, making disciples, and building a community of believers who seek to live out their faith in every aspect of their lives.
